decisions.reason: As the flagship web hosting management platform built directly on the firm's core business and future agency-focused expansion, it remains highly likely to stay in the portfolio.

The configurable managed hosting plan still fits the firm's core offer and customer base, but as a less strategic offer than the platform it has a moderate chance of being folded into a streamlined package structure.

Extended PHP security support matches the firm's security and compliance positioning and serves legacy client needs, though as a tactical add-on it has some risk of later being phased out as customers migrate.
